test_cases.description: Verify that a task with the minimum valid fields can be added successfully.
test_cases.name: Add Task with Valid Minimal Data

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance with an empty in-memory task list and valid minimal task data (e.g., title: 'Sample Task', description: '', due_date: null).
test_setup.then: A Task object is created with a new unique ID, appended to the task list, saved to the JSON file, and returned.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called with the minimal valid data.

test_cases.description: Verify that a task with all possible fields populated is added successfully.
test_cases.name: Add Task with All Fields Populated

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance with an empty task list and task data containing all fields populated (e.g., title, description, due_date, priority, tags).
test_setup.then: A Task object with a new ID is created, appended, saved, and returned with all fields correctly set.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called with the complete data.

test_cases.description: Verify that the ID counter increments correctly when multiple tasks are added.
test_cases.name: ID Increment on Multiple Adds

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance with an empty task list.
test_setup.then: Each returned Task has a unique, incrementing ID, and the tasks are appended and persisted.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called multiple times with different valid task data.

test_cases.description: Verify that tasks are saved to the JSON file after addition.
test_cases.name: Task Persistence to JSON File

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance with access to a valid JSON file and in-memory task list.
test_setup.then: The task is persisted to the JSON file; subsequent loads from the file should include the new task.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called with valid data.

test_cases.description: Verify that task creation is logged as expected.
test_cases.name: Log Creation of Task

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance with logging enabled.
test_setup.then: A log entry is created indicating the task was added, including the task ID.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that adding a task without a required field (title) raises an error or is handled gracefully.
test_cases.name: Add Task with Missing Required Field (Title)

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance and task data missing the 'title' field.
test_setup.then: An error is raised, or the function returns an error response indicating the missing field.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called with incomplete data.

test_cases.description: Verify that adding a task with an incorrect type for a field results in a handled error.
test_cases.name: Add Task with Invalid Field Type

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance and task data where a field (e.g., due_date) is not the expected type (e.g., string instead of datetime).
test_setup.then: An error is raised, or the function returns an error response indicating the invalid type.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify the behavior when attempting to add a task with a title already existing in the task list (if title uniqueness is enforced).
test_cases.name: Add Task with Duplicate Title

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance with a task in the list with title 'Meeting'.
test_setup.then: If title uniqueness is enforced, an error is raised. Otherwise, the task is added with a new ID.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called with a new task with the same title.

test_cases.description: Verify that tasks with empty optional fields are handled correctly.
test_cases.name: Add Task with Empty Optional Fields

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance and task data with optional fields set to empty values (e.g., description: '', tags: []).
test_setup.then: The task is added successfully, and optional fields are stored as empty.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify behavior when task fields contain very large values (e.g., title 255 characters, description 2048 characters).
test_cases.name: Add Task with Large Field Values

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance and task data with very large strings for fields.
test_setup.then: The task is added if within allowed limits, or an error is raised if limits are exceeded.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify that tasks with special characters are handled and stored correctly.
test_cases.name: Add Task with Special Characters in Fields

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance and task data with special characters (e.g., emoji, newline, quotes) in title or description.
test_setup.then: The task is added successfully, and special characters are preserved in storage.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify the behavior when the JSON file for persistence does not exist.
test_cases.name: Add Task When JSON File Is Missing

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance referencing a non-existent JSON file.
test_setup.then: The function creates the file and persists the task, or raises an error if unable to create the file.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify the behavior when the JSON file is read-only and cannot be written to.
test_cases.name: Add Task When JSON File Is Read-Only

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance with the JSON file set to read-only permissions.
test_setup.then: An error is raised indicating failure to persist, and the task is not added to the in-memory list.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify the behavior when the ID counter exceeds the maximum allowed value (e.g., integer overflow).
test_cases.name: Add Task When ID Counter Exceeds Max Value

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance with the ID counter set to the maximum integer value.
test_setup.then: An error is raised, or the function handles the overflow gracefully (wraps or resets the ID counter).
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called.

test_cases.description: Verify the behavior when the existing JSON file contains invalid or corrupted data.
test_cases.name: Add Task When Existing JSON File Is Invalid

test_setup.given: A TaskRepository instance with a JSON file containing corrupted content.
test_setup.then: An error is raised, or the function handles the corruption and resets the file.
test_setup.when: TaskRepository.add_task is called.
